services.name: Morning Cruise
services.desc: An easygoing two-hour charter with the whole River Skipper II reserved for your group of up to 40. The private afternoon cruise is the easygoing middle of our charter lineup: no early call time, no late night, just two golden hours on the Manatee River with the whole boat reserved for your group. It is a favorite for luncheons, retirement parties, milestone birthdays, office celebrations, and family gatherings where three generations all need to be comfortable. You set the tone. Keep our crew's guided storytelling about the river and its history, or skip the narration, bring your own playlist, and simply enjoy having Florida's largest tiki boat to yourselves.
